opportunity_name: Fondo de Conservación, Recuperación y Manejo Sustentable del Bosque Nativo (Ley 20.283)
eligible_actor: forest landowner (two lines: pequeños propietarios + otros interesados; municipalities eligible as landowners)
amount_note: 2026 concurso: total ~CLP 6,975,575,000. Per-hectare bonificación; literal C cap ~10 UTM/ha. Funds raleos, podas, establecimiento de regeneración, cortafuegos, cercos, obras de conservación de suelos, PFNM, asesoría profesional. Two lines: small owners (CONAF accompanies the whole process) and other interested parties.

opportunity_name: Subsidio Nacional al Transporte Público — renovación de flota / buses cero emisión (Fondos de Apoyo Regional)
funder_name: Ministerio de Transportes y Telecomunicaciones (MTT) — División de Transporte Público Regional (DTPR)
eligible_actor: public transport operator (fleet renewal); GORE administers
access_pathway: intermediated (operator applies via GORE/SEREMI/DTPR platform; municipality/GORE structurally involved)
amount_note: Reformed subsidy law (Aug 2024) earmarks >=50% of regional Fondos de Apoyo Regional (FAR) to operation + fleet renewal; incentivises zero-emission buses, charging infrastructure and public bicycles. 1,028 electric buses awarded for incorporation 2026-27; 396 e-buses already operating across regional cities. Per-call amounts set by each GORE's bases.
city_can_apply: no — intermediated (via bank / operator / accredited entity)

opportunity_name: Renueva tu Micro (Programa Especial de Renovación de Buses de Transporte Público)
access_pathway: intermediated (operator applies; not a city grant)
amount_note: Subsidy to scrap and renew buses of regulated/registered public transport; favours lower-emission replacement. Amount varies by vehicle and process (per ChileAtiende ficha 25058).
city_can_apply: no — intermediated (via bank / operator / accredited entity)

opportunity_name: Renueva tu Colectivo (Programa de Renovación de Taxis Colectivos)

amount_note: ~CLP 6.8M special subsidy for electric replacement; figures of ~CLP 7.7M and up to ~CLP 9M cited with scrappage (vary by region/process). Reajustado cada marzo.
city_can_apply: no — intermediated (via bank / operator / accredited entity)

opportunity_name: Transición a la Agricultura Sostenible (TAS)

city_can_apply: facilitated — city enables applicants, not a direct city grant

opportunity_name: Sistema de Incentivos para la Sustentabilidad Agroambiental de los Suelos Agropecuarios (SIRSD-S)
